sections.hypothesis: After a bullish change of character on BTC or ETH 4h bars, the first pullback into the 61.8% retracement of the impulse leg that also reaches a fair value gap from that leg continues to a 4R target often enough to make money after costs: more than the roughly 21-22% win rate a 4R target needs to break even.
sections.rationale: Claimed by a course seller (Craig Percoco, 'Give me 25 minutes...', ~29:10), not by independent evidence. The proposed mechanism: a break of the down-trend's last lower high shows buyers taking control, and late buyers and stopped-out sellers drive a continuation after the first pullback. Weak point: these levels are widely watched, so it's unclear why any edge would survive. The test is whether it does.
sections.rules: Long only, 4h bars. Swing high/low = a bar's high (low) beats the 3 bars each side; known only 3 bars later. Setup: the latest known swing high is lower than the one before, and a bar closes above it (change of character). Leg = lowest low since that swing high up to the highest high since. Fair value gap = three bars where the third bar's low is above the first bar's high; use its midpoint. Signal at a bar's close: its low reaches the leg's 61.8% retracement and the midpoint of a leg gap lying between the 50% and 78.6% retracements, and it closes above 78.6%. Buy at the next open. Stop at the leg low; target 4R from the signal close. Cancel the setup on a close below the leg low or after 30 bars. One entry per change of character. Risk 1% per trade (spot, no leverage). Differs from the video: no shorts, one timeframe, market entry at the next open, no RSI indicator.
sections.falsification: Run once with the default parameters on BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 4h, 2020-01 to 2025-10 (before the holdout). Reject if, across both: net expectancy after costs is 0R or below; or P(expectancy > 0) is under 90%; or there are fewer than 50 trades (too few to judge); or it doesn't beat the channel-breakout engine test with the same 4R target and 1% risk on the same data. Any parameter change is a new version and new trials.
sections.parameters: swing_bars = 3 (allowed 2-5), target_r = 4 (allowed 3-5), expiry_bars = 30 (allowed 10-60). Only the defaults are pre-registered for trial 1. No tuning: other values count as further trials and need a written reason.
sections.costs: Expect roughly 1-3 setups a month per market. Stops sit at the leg low, typically several percent away on 4h bars, so a 22 bps round trip costs about 0.03-0.1R per trade. At 4R the win rate needed rises only from ~20% to ~21-22% after costs, so costs shouldn't decide this one; too few trades might.

history.reason: Failed its pre-registered test (v1, defaults, BTCUSDT + ETHUSDT 4h, 2020-01..2025-10). Pooled over 160 trades: expectancy +0.057R after costs, 95% CI -0.26R to +0.39R, P(expectancy > 0) 63%, below the 90% required. Win rate 23.1% against a 22.0% break-even. BTC alone (+0.26R, P 82%) is a post-hoc subset and was not acted on. Without the 5 best trades both markets lose money. Costs were 0.09-0.12R per trade, above the 0.03-0.1R the note estimated. The channel-breakout comparison was not needed once a rule had failed.
